recognize_zh: 低倍下兩顆分葉中性球（箭頭）的細胞質邊緣各有一小塊淡藍色包涵體，視野中還散佈大小不一、部分偏大的血小板，而一般大小的血小板很少；包涵體加上巨大血小板是 May-Hegglin 異常的特徵。
features: Two segmented neutrophils with small pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusions at the periphery (arrows)
Scattered platelets of variable size including enlarged forms; normal-sized platelets appear decreased
One large, pale granular platelet at left
describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows two segmented neutrophils, each containing a small pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusion near the membrane (arrows). Platelets are sparse and variable in size, with several enlarged forms. Red cells are normochromic and normocytic. In a patient with thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder); higher magnification and NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence or MYH9 testing can confirm.

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies are accompanied by toxic granulation and vacuoles, and platelet size is normal.
Giant platelets are present without neutrophil inclusions, and ristocetin-induced agglutination is absent.
ITP may show large young platelets but no neutrophil inclusions, and platelet counts respond to immunosuppression.
